prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Keep Your Pet Safe Across Logins", "Your pet progress and profile are linked directly to your primary login email.", "Use this same login on any device to keep your pet status intact.", "Continue Adoption", "Account Protected"]
1: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a companion base to start customizing your pet.", "Select Pet", "Companion Options"]
2: ["Upload Photo or Choose Instant Starter", "Upload a photo for custom pet generation or choose a starter template below.", "Preset choices generate instantly if photo processing is slow.", "Instant Presets"]
3: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Experience", "Discover how your pet lives on your desktop before choosing your customization path."]
4: ["Please sign in with your primary email to avoid duplicate accounts and missing pet progress."]
5: ["Desktop Initialization"]
6: ["Finalize Your Pet's Official Profile", "Your pet configuration is set and ready to be loaded onto your desktop screen.", "Complete Adoption"]
7: ["Step 1 of 3 Completed"]
8: ["Your companion is now active in your desktop system tray.", "Active on Desktop"]
9: ["Your Companion is Ready", "Your desktop pet is setup and running in your desktop background."]

verdicts.problem: Asks the user to upload a personal photo
